purpose: Validate whether Immediate and Deferred opportunity exist as distinct analysis axes — NOT canonical P1 target definition

config.I_definition: mean target-first rate across fixed+vol-scaled policies at delay=0
config.D_definition: mean(proxy_pnl at best delay τ* - proxy_pnl at τ=0) across policies; hindsight scan for analysis only

immediate_definitions.meaning: Can favorable movement be captured by entering at t immediately?
immediate_definitions.captureability: Fraction of policies where target hits before stop (delay=0)
immediate_definitions.robustness: Fraction of policies with positive proxy PnL at delay=0
immediate_definitions.composite_I: Same as captureability — analysis proxy, not canonical F

deferred_definitions.meaning: Does a better entry exist within [t, t+H] even if t is poor?
deferred_definitions.best_delay: Per policy, delay maximizing proxy PnL; consensus = median across policies
deferred_definitions.improvement: best_pnl - immediate_pnl per policy; D = mean improvement
deferred_definitions.hindsight_note: Best entry uses future data — analysis label only, never P1 feature

id_correlation.interpretation_note: Correlation is reference only. Quadrant counts (especially I-low/D-high) matter more than correlation magnitude.

case_ab_analysis.hypothesis_check_note: Pre-specified Case A: I↓ D↑ and Case B: I↑ D? — report actual data, not assumed.

baseline_f_vs_id.note: High F vs I correlation suggests F aligns with immediate capture; compare F vs D to see deferred information inclusion.

sd_f_vs_id.note: High F vs I correlation suggests F aligns with immediate capture; compare F vs D to see deferred information inclusion.

confirmed: Q3 (I-low/D-high) occupies 33.3% of samples — deferred opportunity exists independently of immediate capture for a non-trivial subset.
Case A (n=101): mean I=0.050, mean D=0.001355, terminal=0.0832%
Case B (n=114): mean I=0.688, mean D=0.000391, terminal=-0.0941%
Baseline F correlates with Immediate (spearman=0.704) more strongly than typical random pairing.
hypothesis: I-D spearman=-0.552 — partial overlap exists; quadrant structure still required for interpretation.
unresolved: Canonical scalar vs multi-head P1 target — NOT decided by this experiment
Which execution policy family represents P2 — still unresolved
Deferred best-entry objective varies by policy — no single hindsight ground truth
